main.description: Yyteri Beach Ultimate aka YBU is an ultimate tournament, which is played as loose-mixed (5 vs 5) in Pori's Yyteri on 15 and 16 August 2026. YBU was organised for the first time in 1999.
main.contact: If you have questions concerning the tournament, you can contact us via <0>email</0>, via <1>Instagram</1> and via the <2>WhatsApp community</2>. Welcome to YBU!

general.title: General information about the tournament
content: Playing fields will be built on the beach and a staff tent will be put next to the fields. The easiest way to get to the playing fields and the staff tent is to walk to the beach via the duckboards from the end of Yyterinsantojentie next to Yyteri info building.

There is always a staff member at the staff tent, and you can buy Turku Terror Frisbees from the tent. You can also find a daily game schedule from the tent, where the results of the games will be updated. The results and final rankings will also be updated in the electronic, more accurate game schedule, which will be posted later.
Drinking water can be obtained from the upper end of the duckboards (NB! It is advisable to bring a larger water canister for the team, if available). There are also toilets on the beach.

During the tournament, we will establish a WhatsApp community. The YBU community includes a General group open to everybody. There will also be a group to which the teams' contact persons will be added and where information about the tournament will be shared.
Teams should bring their own first aid supplies.

fees.title: Fees
content: The team fee is 320 € and it covers 8 players. Extra players can be bought for 40 € / player. The team fee and extra player fees will be paid in YBU Holvi. Team fee and possible extra players should be paid in Holvi by 1.8.

travel.description: The easiest way to Yyteri Beach is by car. If you need a ride, write a message to YBU whatsapp community and let’s try to arrange car pools.

general.title: General rules
content: Games are up to 11 points (hard cap), time cap 30 minutes. Same rules apply for finals.

When the time cap is reached, the current point is finished. If one team leads by 3 or more points when the time is up, then the game is over (pagacap). If not and neither team has reached 11 points, the new point cap will be the leading team’s score +1.

Announcements on the loudspeaker are “Pelikello käy” (game starts), “15 minuuttia pelattu” (15 minutes played) and “peliaika päättynyt” (game time is over). At 15 minutes there is an opportunity for a 1 minute long water break.
No half time. No time-outs. No brick rule. Callahan goals apply.
Mixed rule: Both men and women from each team have to be on the field at every point. Teams decide themselves how many men and women they put on the field.
No visiting players are allowed in the quarter finals, semi finals or final match.

overview.title: Overview of beach ultimate rules
overview.description: The tournament will be played with the official BULA 5-on-5 Beach Ultimate rules with mixed teams (both men and women have to be on the field at every point). Here's an overview of the most important rules:

content.title: The Field
content.rule: The field for 5-on-5 BULA Beach Ultimate consists of a 45 m x 25 m rectangle called the playing field proper, with a 15 m by 25 m rectangle called an end zone aligned along each of the 25 m sides.

content.title: Start of the game
content.rule: The winner of the coin (or Frisbee) toss determines whether it will start on offence or decides what end zone to defend first. Next, both teams line up on the front of their respective end zone line. The defence throws the disc to the offence and the game begins.

content.title: Movement of the disc and the players
content.rule: The disc can be thrown from one player to another in any direction. A player may not run while in possession of the disc.

content.title: Possession
content.rule: The person with the disc has 10 seconds to throw the disc to a teammate. The defender guarding the thrower counts the seconds out loud ("stalling one, two, three...").

content.title: Change of possession
content.rule: A turnover results whenever one of the following items occur:
bullets: the disc touches the ground (also when knocked down by the defence)
the disc is caught outside the field
the disc is intercepted by an opposing player
content.ending: Upon a turnover the defence immediately takes possession of the disc and becomes the offence.

content.title: Scoring
content.rule: A goal is scored when a player catches a legal pass in the end zone of the attack. Play is initiated after each score.

content.title: Initiate Play
content.rule: Each new point begins again with both teams lining up on the front of their respective end zone line with the team that just scored throwing the disc to the other team.

content.title: Non-contact
content.rule: Beach Ultimate is a non-contact sport. A foul occurs when contact is made.

content.title: No Referees
content.rule: The sport is self-officiated. All fouls are called by the player(s) involved. When a foul results in loss of possession, the play is stopped and resumed as if possession was not lost. If the player committing the foul disagrees with the foul call, the play is redone.

spirit.title: Spirit of the Game
spirit.description: The Spirit of the Game is not so much a rule, but an attitude... a way of playing. It relies upon a spirit of sportsmanship that places the responsibility for fair play on the players themselves. Highly competitive play is encouraged, but never at the expense of mutual respect between players. The Spirit of the Game is one of the fundamental beliefs of the Beach Ultimate sport. Without it the game loses its charm. The Spirit must exist!
